ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #15
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Word Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Word Reading.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word Reading.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Word Reading.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Word Reading.

2. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library?
   B. Where is the library
   C. Where is the Library
   D. where is the library

3. When practising Connected text and fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text and fluency.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Connected text and fluency.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Connected text and fluency.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Connected text and fluency.

4. When practising Pre Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre Reading.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Pre Reading.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Pre Reading.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Pre Reading.

5. When practising Phonics, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Phonics.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Phonics.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Phonics.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonics.

6. When practising Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Handwriting.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Handwriting.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Handwriting.

7. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. run
   B. quickly
   C. happiness
   D. blue

8. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.

9. When practising Language Welcome and, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Welcome and.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Language Welcome and.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Language Welcome and.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Language Welcome and.

10. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. Many unrelated topics with no link
   B. Only one word repeated
   C. No full stops
   D. One main idea with supporting sentences

11. When practising Language School, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Language School.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Language School.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language School.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Language School.

12. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. went
   B. going
   C. goed
   D. goes

13. When practising Pre-Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre-Writing.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Pre-Writing.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Pre-Writing.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Pre-Writing.

14. When practising Attentive listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Attentive listening.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive listening.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Attentive listening.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive listening.

15. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. A person, place, thing, or idea
   B. Only an action
   C. Only a describing word
   D. Only a joining word

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Word Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Connected text and fluency and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Pre-Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Handwriting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Punctuation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Attentive listening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Language Welcome and and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Language School and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
